notes: Fixture photos are not committed (tests/fixtures/ is gitignored): copy the radar station Lightroom exports into fixtureDir, then run `npm run calibrate`.
Flags compare each frame with its own camera's median (the page's rule); the set medians below are checked across all cameras.

frame.index is the 1-based position in capture-time order (calibration only; the page keeps the order photos were added); frame.name matches a filename substring (shortest match wins, so the original export beats '-2' or '-edit' variants). If 'image 17' means a filename, swap index for name.
If a check misses, fix the metric definitions in the core script, not the thresholds.
